about: Leads for Syracuse (Siracusa), started from a reader tip on r/sicily, 2026-10-23.

leads.name: The big trees by the Fonte Aretusa
leads.species: to confirm (likely Moreton Bay Fig, Ficus macrophylla, along the Foro Italico)
leads.place: Fonte Aretusa and the Foro Italico promenade, Ortigia, Syracuse
leads.source: reader tip on r/sicily, 2026-10-23 (no name kept): 'those ones in Giardino Aretusa in Syracuse'
leads.note: Coordinates are the spring, not a trunk. The MASAF register has no row in the comune of Siracusa, so this needs the city's own list, a second source and a photo (Commons, or the tipster). Species is our guess from the promenade, to confirm, never published as such.

leads.name: The fig of Ortigia, and a giant cactus near the old Zimmiti shop
leads.species: Fig (Ficus sp.) and a cactus, both to confirm
leads.place: Ortigia, Syracuse; the cactus 'kinda near the Zimmiti shop, in the direction towards Archimede school'
leads.source: reader tip on r/sicily, 2026-10-24 (no name kept): 'there is a ficus tree in Ortigia, But I dunno its age, also there is (or was...) the most enormous cactus tree I ever seen'
leads.note: Childhood memory, the tipster says they left as a kid, so the cactus may be gone. The Ortigia fig may be the same promenade fig as the Fonte Aretusa lead above; fold them if so. A cactus is not a tree page unless it is a tree-form species and big for it.
